text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived from the
facility where Admire Groove grew up—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: More importantly, it's time for training, right?
choice_data_list: You sure you don't need to read it thoroughly?
Aren't you going to read it carefully?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
To me... training is more important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove completes her assigned training in her usual composed manner.

text_block_list.name: Letter Message
text_block_list.text:
"The day after Big Sis races,
everyone talks about nothing but Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Letter Message
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis is our pride.
Big Sis is our dream.
Big Sis—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I want to... live up to these feelings—!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Good work. That's all for today.
Good work. That's all for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to stop her, but the words caught in my throat.
Admire Groove was... completely serious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's surely thanks to that letter.
If so, as her Trainer,
I want to give her a push forward.
choice_data_list: ...All right, let's keep going until we're completely satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched over her for a while
as she trained with all her might!
